verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is an AI-driven game engine with a CLI, an MCP server and hosted services, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to opt out. The only analytics evidence concerns player analytics that developers read about their own games, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
